title: Users
guidance: Manage the people who can sign in to this organization.
scope: Roles apply to every fleet in this organization. Only Administrators can manage users.
heading: Organization users
name: Name
emptyDescription: Create a user to give someone access to this organization.
errorText: Users could not be loaded. Try again.
preferencesError: The selected fleet's date preferences could not be loaded. Retry to show the users with the correct dates.

confirmDeactivate.title: Deactivate this user?
confirmDeactivate.detail: The user will be signed out and will no longer be able to sign in. You can reactivate them later. Deactivating your own account also signs you out.

confirmReactivate.title: Reactivate this user?
confirmReactivate.detail: The user will be able to sign in with their existing password and assigned role.

drawer.guidance: Set the account name, email and organization role.
drawer.passwordHint: Use 12–128 characters. Share this password securely; the user can change it in Profile.
drawer.emailInUse: This email is already in use.
drawer.saveError: The user could not be saved. Check the form and try again.
drawer.roleHint: Viewer: read only. Operator: device reads and fleet operations. Engineer: configuration writes and snapshots. Administrator: all actions, users and fleet settings.
drawer.ownRole: You cannot change your own role. Another Administrator must do this.

administratorRequired: An Administrator role is required to create, edit, deactivate or reactivate users.
moduleInfo: Users lists the accounts that can sign in to this organization, with their roles and account status. Organization administrators can create accounts, update their details and manage access. Roles apply across all fleets in the organization.
